chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v01] By the individual means and its rule, this is determined for those who desire the supreme abode.

[tal-a05-v10] Established in realization of one's own nature, supreme through unfolding knowledge, consciousness-nature is true through conception of freedom's expansion.

[tal-a05-v02] When conceptualization is purified and the desired thing is unopposed, attainment of enjoyment and liberation is certain.

[tal-a05-v03] Conceptualization becomes very stable when it arises from one's own self-freedom, without dependence on other means.

[tal-a05-v04] For someone, conceptualization directed toward self-purification is said to depend on other means, according to the previous rule.

[tal-a05-v05] Conceptualization is called the nature of pure consciousness; though situated, it still joins freedom for the limited self.

[tal-a05-v06] Certainty is manifold, and the means there are distinct; they are spoken of by the word anu according to far and near.

[tal-a05-v07] Ultimate truth shines in intellect, breath, body, and cognizer, even in what is non-ultimate.

[tal-a05-v08] Because it is non-different from pure consciousness light, that body of inert and conscious is doubled through freedom.

[tal-a05-v09] In Traishirasa it is said to the goddess: the individual soul is Shiva's power, situated everywhere.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-:C5 atha śrītantrāloke pañcamamāhnikam āṇavena vidhinā paradhāma prepsatāmatha nirūpyata etat vikalpasyaiva saṃskāre jāte niṣpratiyogini / abhīṣṭe vastuni prāptirniścitā bhogamokṣayoḥ vikalpaḥ kasyacitsvātmasvātantryādeva susthiraḥ / upāyāntarasāpekṣyaviyogenaiva jāyate kasyacittu vikalpo@sau svātmasaṃskaraṇaṃ prati / upāyāntarasāpekṣastatroktaḥ pūrvako vidhiḥ vikalpo nāma cinmātrasvabhāvo yadyapi sthitaḥ / tathāpi niścayātmāsāvaṇoḥ svātantryayojakaḥ niścayo bahudhā caiṣa tatropāyāśca bhedinaḥ / aṇuśabdena te coktā dūrāntikavibhedataḥ tatra buddhau tathā prāṇe dehe cāpi pramātari / apāramārthike@pyasmin paramārthaḥ prakāśate yataḥ prakāśāccinmātrāt prāṇādyavyatirekavat / tasyaiva tu svatantratvāddviguṇaṃ jaḍacidvapuḥ uktaṃ traiśirase caitaddevyai candrārdhamaulinā / jīvaḥ śaktiḥ śivasyaiva sarvatraiva sthitāpi sā svarūpapratyaye rūḍhā jñānasyonmīlanātparā / tasya cidrūpatāṃ satyāṃ svātantryollāsakalpanāt

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v11] There, hiding duality by seeing the inert-self portion, one may become non-dual by the view of freedom, like a face in a mirror.

[tal-a05-v12] Pure own consciousness is determined as that nature, distinct from intellect, breath, and the rest, by force.

[tal-a05-v13] From purity alone arises the non-difference of world-form with truth, since mutual difference would divide it.

[tal-a05-v14] Even if forms conflict, all being remains within consciousness rather than resting otherwise in intellect.

[tal-a05-v15] Even so, in this doubt-free state there is no doubt without that support.

[tal-a05-v16] But certainty in intellect, breath, and body comes directly through supreme lordship.

[tal-a05-v17] What is imagined has void-form, but imagining does not occur in the knower; there intellect is meditation and breath is utterance.

[tal-a05-v18] Utterance includes five breath functions from prana to vyana, and the first would be supreme utterance-natured.

[tal-a05-v19] The body is established as a mass of sense objects; there the meditation-made supreme is spoken here.

[tal-a05-v20] The independent consciousness-natured light situated in the heart is all-principle-made, as said in the trishira doctrine.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-paśyañjaḍātmatābhāgaṃ tirodhāyādvayo bhavet / tatra svātantryadṛṣṭyā vā darpaṇe mukhabimbavat viśuddhaṃ nijacaitanyaṃ niścinotyatadātmakam / buddhiprāṇādito bhinnaṃ caitanyaṃ niścitaṃ balāt satyatastadabhinnaṃ syāttasyānyonyavibhedataḥ / viśvarūpāvibheditvaṃ śuddhatvādeva jāyate niṣṭhitaikasphuranmūrtermūrtyantaravirodhataḥ / antaḥ saṃvidi satsarvaṃ yadyapyaparathā dhiyi prāṇe dehe@thavā kasmātsaṃkrāmetkena vā katham / tathāpi nirvikalpe@sminvikalpo nāsti taṃ vinā dṛṣṭe@pyadṛṣṭakalpatvaṃ vikalpena tu niścayaḥ / buddhiprāṇaśarīreṣu pārameśvaryamañjasā vikalpyaṃ śūnyarūpe na pramātari vikalpanam / buddhirdhyānamayī tatra prāṇa uccāraṇātmakaḥ uccāraṇaṃ ca prāṇādyā vyānāntāḥ pañca vṛttayaḥ / ādyā tu prāṇanābhikhyāparoccārātmikā bhavet śarīrasyākṣaviṣayaitatpiṇḍatvena saṃsthitiḥ / tatra dhyānamayaṃ tāvadanuttaramihocyate yaḥ prakāśaḥ svatantro@yaṃ citsvabhāvo hṛdi sthitaḥ / sarvatattvamayaḥ proktametacca triśiromate

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v21] The principle-knower sees within the heart a banana-sheath-shaped form with outer, inner, and middle, like a flower.

[tal-a05-v22] There one should meditate with unwavering mind on the conjunction of moon, sun, and fire; that meditation agitation makes great Bhairava consume offerings.

[tal-a05-v23] Blazing in the great heart-basin, fullness would arise for that power-possessor with expanded power and Bhairava radiance.

[tal-a05-v24] One should contemplate knower, knowing, and known by abode non-difference; the fire, sun, and moon powers become that same triad.

[tal-a05-v25] The supreme, supreme-and-lower, and lower goddesses are always arisen; through creation, preservation, and dissolution they are individually threefold.

[tal-a05-v26] The fourth unlimited form of them is unimagined; thus twelve goddesses are situated like sun discs.

[tal-a05-v27] Of each of them, fire, sun, moon, and their peace-radiance is this supreme wheel, from heart and eyes and so on.

[tal-a05-v28] It goes indeed through voids in each object domain; by that wheel radiance there in meaning, by creation, preservation, and dissolution order.

[tal-a05-v29] The moon-sun-fire radiance-nature form stands together; thus in sound and other objects, by the ear and other void paths.

[tal-a05-v30] By this falling wheel one should contemplate identity; by this ordered union, wherever that falls.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-kadalīsaṃpuṭākāraṃ sabāhyābhyantarāntaram / īkṣate hṛdayāntaḥsthaṃ tatpuṣpamiva tattvavit somasūryāgnisaṃghaṭṭaṃ tatra dhyāyedananyadhīḥ / taddhyānāraṇisaṃkṣobhānmahābhairavahavyabhuk hṛdayākhye mahākuṇḍe jājvalan sphītatāṃ vrajet / tasya śaktimataḥ sphītaśakterbhairavatejasaḥ mātṛmānaprameyākhyaṃ dhāmābhedena bhāvayet / vahnyarkasomaśaktīnāṃ tadeva tritayaṃ bhavet parā parāparā ceyamaparā ca sadoditā / sṛṣṭisaṃsthitisaṃhāraistāsāṃ pratyekatastridhā caturthaṃ cānavacchinnaṃ rūpamāsāmakalpitam / evaṃ dvādaśa tā devyaḥ sūryabimbavadāsthitāḥ ekaikamāsāṃ vahnyarkasomatacchāntibhāsanam / etadānuttaraṃ cakraṃ hṛdayāccakṣurādibhiḥ vyomabhirniḥsaratyeva tattadviṣayagocare / taccakrabhābhistatrārthe sṛṣṭisthitilayakramāt somasūryāgnibhāsātma rūpaṃ samavatiṣṭhate / evaṃ śabdādiviṣaye śrotrādivyomavartmanā cakreṇānena patatā tādātmyaṃ paribhāvayet / anena kramayogena yatra yatra patatyadaḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v31] The all-natured wheel, like each all-earthly king, thus dissolves the world path layer effortlessly.

[tal-a05-v32] In the Bhairava great wheel surrounded by consciousness, then by impression only, even the world is destroyed.

[tal-a05-v33] By own self rising, one should meditate the great revolving wheel; then by that burnable dissolution and that impression destruction.

[tal-a05-v34] One should contemplate the calming wheel; then peaceful, then peace; by this meditation union the world dissolves in the wheel.

[tal-a05-v35] In that consciousness, then consciousness-dissolved meaning alone shines; by consciousness nature, then again creation, which is conscious great lady.

[tal-a05-v36] Thus every moment, dissolving and emitting the world in own consciousness, then again one should go to perpetual Bhairava state.

[tal-a05-v37] Thus, from trishula onward, by the four-five-ara sequence up to fifty ara, the yogi should visualize the wheel.

[tal-a05-v38] Or the sixty-four-hundred-ara wheel, or the thousand-ara wheel, or the countless-thousand-ara wheel, the one of undivided mind should meditate.

[tal-a05-v39] Of the great lord of consciousness, of the god of arising consciousness, there is no calculation at all of the great lord of world-power.

[tal-a05-v40] His powers are the whole world; the power-holder is the great lord. Thus, in the auspicious scripture, Sri Srikantha explained.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-cakraṃ sarvātmakaṃ tattatsārvabhaumamahīśavat / itthaṃ viśvādhvapaṭalamayatnenaiva līyate bhairavīyamahācakre saṃvittiparivārite / tataḥ saṃskāramātreṇa viśvasyāpi parikṣaye svātmocchalattayā bhrāmyaccakraṃ saṃcintayenmahat / tatastaddāhyavilayāt tatsaṃskāraparikṣayāt praśāmyadbhāvayeccakraṃ tataḥ śāntaṃ tataḥ śamam / anena dhyānayogena viśvaṃ cakre vilīyate tatsaṃvidi tataḥ saṃvidvilīnārthaiva bhāsate / citsvābhāvyāt tato bhūyaḥ sṛṣṭiryaccinmaheśvarī evaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ viśvaṃ svasaṃvidi vilāpayan / visṛjaṃśca tato bhūyaḥ śaśvadbhairavatāṃ vrajet evaṃ triśūlāt prabhṛti catuṣpañcārakakramāt / pañcāśadaraparyantaṃ cakraṃ yogī vibhāvayet catuṣṣaṣṭiśatāraṃ vā sahasrāramathāpi vā / asaṃkhyārasahasraṃ vā cakraṃ dhyāyedananyadhīḥ saṃvinnāthasya mahato devasyollāsisaṃvidaḥ / naivāsti kācitkalanā viśvaśaktermaheśituḥ śaktayo@sya jagat kṛtsnaṃ śaktimāṃstu maheśvaraḥ / iti māṅgalaśāstre tu śrīśrīkaṇṭho nyarūpayat

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v41] Thus this first-means-form meditation was explained by Sri Shambhunatha; to me, Sri Sumatiprabhu was pleased to him.

[tal-a05-v42] By this same direction, other meditations too should be resorted to, those that reach the burden of the unexcelled means without sequence.

[tal-a05-v43] Now, breath's function, beginning with prana, is explained; by that means we speak of unexcelled expansion.

[tal-a05-v44] Situated formerly in the heart in own bliss, in the measure of knower and object, from rest in mere void, one should visualize the blissless.

[tal-a05-v45] At breath rising, in the object, one should visualize supreme bliss; there, freed by filling endless object parts with apana.

[tal-a05-v46] Standing in supreme bliss, adorned by the apana moon, then one is freed by the single contact of endless shining objects.

[tal-a05-v47] Having reached the samana level, one becomes full of brahma bliss; then also one is intent on swallowing the mass of knower-known calculation.

[tal-a05-v48] Resting in udana fire, one should visualize great bliss; there, having reached rest, one becomes calm in that great flame.

[tal-a05-v49] Then indeed consciousness-bliss, not strengthened by the insentient, is the great pervasion free from support.

[tal-a05-v50] Here no divided abiding of insentient form exists; where shining appears from all sides, no separation exists.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-ityetat prathamopāyarūpaṃ dhyānaṃ nyarūpayat / śrīśaṃbhunātho me tuṣṭastasmai śrīsumatiprabhuḥ anayaiva diśānyāni dhyānānyapi samāśrayet / anuttaropāyadhurāṃ yānyāyānti kramaṃ vinā atha prāṇasya yā vṛttiḥ prāṇanādyā nirūpitā / tadupāyatayā brūmo@nuttarapravikāsanam nijānande pramātraṃśamātre hṛdi purā sthitaḥ / śūnyatāmātraviśrānternirānandaṃ vibhāvayet prāṇodaye prameye tu parānandaṃ vibhāvayet / tatrānantaprameyāṃśapūraṇāpānanirvṛtaḥ parānandagatastiṣṭhedapānaśaśiśobhitaḥ / tato@nantasphuranmeyasaṃghaṭṭaikāntanirvṛtaḥ samānabhūmimāgatya brahmānandamayo bhavet / tato@pi mānameyaughakalanāgrāsatatparaḥ udānavahnau viśrānto mahānandaṃ vibhāvayat / tatra viśrāntimabhyetya śāmyatyasminmahārciṣi nirupādhirmahāvyāptirvyānākhyopādhivarjitā / tadā khalu cidānando yo jaḍānupabṛṃhitaḥ nahyatra saṃsthitiḥ kāpi vibhaktā jaḍarūpiṇaḥ / yatra ko@pi vyavacchedo nāsti yadviśvataḥ sphurat

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v51] Unstruck awareness, strengthened by supreme nectar, is where meditations have no primary connection.

[tal-a05-v52] That world-bliss Shambhu gives us; there rest is to be taken by heart-utterance.

[tal-a05-v53] That right rest there is the supreme abiding, even in heart and other one-natured places, in one's own abode.

[tal-a05-v54] The sixfold breath-born form is then called pervasion by use of the breath staff, equalizing prior and later.

[tal-a05-v55] Dwell in the four-petaled lotus hanging palace; having crossed the trident ground, reach the three-channel-joined state.

[tal-a05-v56] When will, knowledge, action, and power are equal, the wise one enters one expanding, more-contracted, radiant state.

[tal-a05-v57] Dwell on the brow-point sound-end power staircase; there on the upward coiled ground a beautiful throb arises.

[tal-a05-v58] Emission rests there in the fish-belly state, as a she-donkey or mare rests in its own abode, a temple of bliss.

[tal-a05-v59] Entering the expansion-contraction in the heart, one rejoices in the momentary full crowd of absorbed and emitted states.

[tal-a05-v60] Dwell in the expansion-contraction-rooted Bhairava couple, the unified great root trident emission, in the heart.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-yadanāhatasaṃvitti paramāmṛtabṛṃhitam / yatrāsti bhāvanādīnāṃ na mukhyā kāpi saṃgatiḥ tadeva jagadānandamasmabhyaṃ śaṃbhurūcivān / tatra viśrāntirādheyā hṛdayoccārayogataḥ yā tatra samyagviśrāntiḥ sānuttaramayī sthitiḥ / ityetaddhṛdayādyekasvabhāve@pi svadhāmani ṣaṭprāṇoccārajaṃ rūpamatha vyāptyā taducyate / prāṇadaṇḍaprayogena pūrvāparasamīkṛteḥ catuṣkikāmbujālambilambikāsaudhamāśrayet / triśūlabhūmiṃ krāntvāto nāḍitritayasaṅgatām icchājñānakriyāśaktisamatve praviśet sudhīḥ / ekāṃ vikāsinīṃ bhūyastvasaṃkocāṃ vikasvarām śrayedbhrūbindunādāntaśaktisopānamālikām / tatrordhvakuṇḍalībhūmau spandanodarasundaraḥ visargastatra viśrāmyenmatsyodaradaśājuṣi / rāsabhī vaḍavā yadvatsvadhāmānandamandiram vikāsasaṃkocamayaṃ praviśya hṛdi hṛṣyati / tadvanmuhurlīnasṛṣṭabhāvavrātasunirbharām śrayedvikāsasaṃkocarūḍhabhairavayāmalām / ekīkṛtamahāmūlaśūlavaisargike hṛdi

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v61] Here rest in the supreme, through all-filling union, is established as world-entry by that full activity alone.

[tal-a05-v62] In supreme reflection free from prior activity, let the self-rest of light be seen as I-am.

[tal-a05-v63] The supreme I-maker of consciousness reflection first shines; then, by effort, he becomes the twelve-part self.

[tal-a05-v64] Let the sun illuminate being, then fill and contemplate; then the sixteen-part moon slowly devours emission.

[tal-a05-v65] The reviving nectar is emitted into consciousness fire, throbbing through the subtle channel of will, knowledge, and action powers.

[tal-a05-v66] That divine nectar, satisfying among consciousness goddesses, is emission nectar thus far in the fire of offering called consciousness.

[tal-a05-v67] If all becomes emitted and offered, the sixfold path circle arises; because of the supreme lord, emission and clan leader agitation expand from ka to ha as reality path.

[tal-a05-v68] Thus aṃ, accompanied by the clan mistress, indeed makes clan lordship supreme; the world is called that which is filled by emission separation.

[tal-a05-v69] Thus worship, offer, and meditate upon this reviving phase filled with consciousness, breath, quality, body, and outer substance.

[tal-a05-v70] Situated with two bliss channels pulsing attentively, he approaches this ground of emission flow and palace.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-parasminneti viśrāntiṃ sarvāpūraṇayogataḥ / atra tatpūrṇavṛttyaiva viśvāveśamayaṃ sthitam prakāśasyātmaviśrāntāvahamityeva dṛśyatām / anuttaravimarśe prāgvyāpārādivivarjite cidvimarśaparāhaṃkṛt prathamollāsinī sphuret / tata udyogasaktena sa dvādaśakalātmanā sūryeṇābhāsayedbhāvaṃ pūrayedatha carcayet / athenduḥ ṣoḍaśakalo visargagrāsamantharaḥ saṃjīvanyamṛtaṃ bodhavahnau visṛjati sphuran / icchājñānakriyāśaktisūkṣmarandhrasrugagragam tadevama[tada]mṛtaṃ divyaṃ saṃviddevīṣu tarpakam / visargāmṛtametāvad bodhākhye hutabhojini visṛṣṭaṃ cedbhavetsarvaṃ hutaṃ ṣoḍhādhvamaṇḍalam / yato@nuttaranāthasya visargaḥ kulanāyikā / tatkṣobhaḥ kādihāntaṃ tatprasarastattvapaddhatiḥ aṃa iti kuleśvaryā sahito hi kuleśitā / paro visargaviśleṣastanmayaṃ viśvamucyate vitprāṇaguṇadehāntarbahirdravyamayīmimām / arcayejjuhuyāddhyāyeditthaṃ saṃjīvanīṃ kalām ānandanāḍīyugalaspandanāvahitau sthitaḥ / enāṃ visarganiḥṣyandasaudhabhūmiṃ prapadyate

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v71] In shakti agitation, clan entry, pervasion at tips of all channels, and all-self contraction, the wise one enters the heart.

[tal-a05-v72] From mutual friction of moon and sun phase nets, in the fire-moon abode, emission bliss opens.

[tal-a05-v73] Enough of secret talk; this is hidden by its own nature. Resting there in the yogini-heart, the wise one becomes accomplished.

[tal-a05-v74] Grown familiar in the conduct of rejecting, accepting, and disregarding, one sees the universe from non-dual conduct, out of consciousness-relish.

[tal-a05-v75] Abandoning prayer born of neediness in outer and inner self, reaching cessation-bliss in sky-form, one resorts to the blossomed sound-stage.

[tal-a05-v76] With the mouth within, rightly bloom consciousness forth; the lofty imperishable wheel of consciousness, non-different from the knowable, becomes thence.

[tal-a05-v77] That knowable is dissolved away by the consciousness-named fire; dissolved, it dissolves in the power-fire of the triangle here.

[tal-a05-v78] There, well at peace in noble perception-drop-being, rested in the withdrawal seed, the yogi becomes supreme-measured.

[tal-a05-v79] In inner and outer both, beautiful beyond common and uncommon, the self of consciousness-throb and three powers holds contraction and expansion.

[tal-a05-v80] Even uncontracted expansion, from its shining forth thus, aimed within with outward gaze, reaches the supreme state.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-śākte kṣobhe kulāveśe sarvanāḍyagragocare / vyāptau sarvātmasaṃkoce hṛdayaṃ praviśetsudhīḥ somasūryakalājālaparasparanigharṣataḥ / agnīṣomātmake dhāmni visargānanda unmiṣet alaṃ rahasyakathayā guptametatsvabhāvataḥ / yoginīhṛdayaṃ tatra viśrāntaḥ syātkṛtī budhaḥ hānādānatiraskāravṛttau rūḍhimupāgataḥ / abhedavṛttitaḥ paśyedviśvaṃ citicamatkṛteḥ arthakriyārthitādainyaṃ tyaktvā bāhyāntarātmani / kharūpe nirvṛtiṃ prāpya phullāṃ nādadaśāṃ śrayet vaktramantastayā samyak saṃvidaḥ pravikāsayet / saṃvidakṣamaruccakraṃ jñeyābhinnaṃ tato bhavet tajjñeyaṃ saṃvidākhyena vahninā pravilīyate / vilīnaṃ tat trikoṇe@smiñśaktivahnau vilīyate tatra saṃvedanodārabindusattāsunirvṛtaḥ / saṃhārabījaviśrānto yogī paramayo bhavet antarbāhye dvaye vāpi sāmānyetarasundaraḥ / saṃvitspandastriśaktyātmā saṃkocapravikāsavān asaṃkocavikāso@pi tadābhāsanatastathā / antarlakṣyo bahirdṛṣṭiḥ paramaṃ padamaśnute

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v81] Then in unmeasured freedom, the wondrous-purpose-act-form reflecting, the distinct throb named eagerness stirs.

[tal-a05-v82] There, coming to rest whose vigor in the mantra-circle, since peace and the powers come from identity with each respective form.

[tal-a05-v83] Divine is this eye-multitude named awareness-freedom; unclosed, he makes just this world self-formed.

[tal-a05-v84] With all activities dissolved in union of great venture, heaped in the flood of own rays, having become full, he stands.

[tal-a05-v85] There, one who does not think the unthinkable goes as clear seer to consciousness, whose sparks are the single cause of burning samsara to ash.

[tal-a05-v86] That was said by the supreme lord in the Trishira Bhairava Agama: listen, goddess, I will declare entry into the mantra plane.

[tal-a05-v87] The upward movement of the middle channel is marked by attaining its nature, beyond the end of the emission word, determined at the extreme limit.

[tal-a05-v88] By blocking the downward flow and avoiding the upward throw, it gives rise to great light, knowledge, and manifestation.

[tal-a05-v89] Having experienced the supreme abode, by measure-activity one may enter the city-body; that waveless descended single activity is shiva-natured.

[tal-a05-v90] Radiant with doubled six wheels, standing there one should examine void, void, standing in void; by the void-dweller one should enter.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tataḥ svātantryanirmeye vicitrārthakriyākṛti / vimarśanaṃ viśeṣākhyaḥ spanda aunmukhyasaṃjñitaḥ tatra viśrāntimāgacchedyadvīryaṃ mantramaṇḍale / śāntyādisiddhayastattadrūpatādātmyato yataḥ divyo yaścākṣasaṃgho@yaṃ bodhasvātantryasaṃjñakaḥ / so@nimīlita evaitat kuryātsvātmamayaṃ jagat mahāsāhasasaṃyogavilīnākhilavṛttikaḥ / puñjībhūte svaraśmyoghe nirbharībhūya tiṣṭhati akiciccintakastatra spaṣṭadṛgyāti saṃvidam / yadvisphuliṅgāḥ saṃsārabhasmadāhaikahetavaḥ taduktaṃ parameśena triśirobhairavāgame / śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi mantrabhūmyāṃ praveśanam madhyanāḍyordhvagamanaṃ taddharmaprāptilakṣaṇam / visargāntapadātītaṃ prāntakoṭinirūpitam adhaḥpravāhasaṃrodhādūrdhvakṣepavivarjanāt / mahāprakāśamudayajñānavyaktipradāyakam anubhūya pare dhāmni mātrāvṛttyā puraṃ viśet / nistaraṅgāvatīrṇā sā vṛttirekā śivātmikā catuṣṣaḍdvirdviguṇitacakraṣaṭkasamujjvalā / tatsthaṃ [tstho] vicārayet khaṃ khaṃ khasthaṃ khasthena saṃviśet

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v100] As long as she is in rava, the female rava dissolves from rava; here by meditation and body-based means on the supreme path.

[tal-a05-v91] Having abandoned void, void, having mounted the void, standing in void one utters void thus; by authority of dwelling in void, rays stand in the word.

[tal-a05-v92] Meditate the inner existing being; standing in being, desireless toward being, having blocked the movements of being and nonbeing, one is the seer of blocking being and nonbeing.

[tal-a05-v93] The roots of the self-atom family are power, being, consciousness, delight; the three powers, tinged by seer and seen, are free from that.

[tal-a05-v94] This void is declared in ten ways as the characteristic of utterance: standing in the abode, standing in the middle of the abode, made into an abode cavity.

[tal-a05-v95] By the abode awaken the abode; make that abode go to the abode's end; by abode movement, the innermost abode end is to be pierced.

[tal-a05-v96] By difference, subdifference, and difference, the difference is to be done from the middle; thus the entry means is proclaimed.

[tal-a05-v97] The glorious ten-formed rava, spoken by me and also said in the holy Brahmayamala, is seated in the heart by Lord Maheshvara.

[tal-a05-v98] Gross, subtle, supreme, heart-pleasing, throat and palatal, and from everywhere, that lord gives the state of lordship.

[tal-a05-v99] The great yogi who conquers rava enters another body and daily obtains supreme pervasion; one should practice him.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-khaṃ khaṃ tyaktvā khamāruhya khasthaṃ khaṃ coccarediti / khamadhyāsyādhikāreṇa padasthāścinmarīcayaḥ bhāvayedbhāvamantaḥsthaṃ bhāvastho bhāvaniḥspṛhaḥ / bhāvābhāvagatī ruddhvā bhāvābhāvāvarodhadṛk ātmāṇukulamūlāni śaktirbhūtiścitī ratiḥ / śaktitrayaṃ draṣṭṛdṛśyoparaktaṃ tadvivarjitam etatkhaṃ daśadhā proktamuccāroccāralakṣaṇam / dhāmasthaṃ dhāmamadhyasthaṃ dhāmodarapuṭīkṛtam dhāmnā tu bodhayeddhāma dhāma dhāmāntagaṃ kuru / taddhāma dhāmagatyā tu bhedyaṃ dhāmāntamāntaram bhedopabhedabhedena bhedaḥ kāryastu madhyataḥ / iti praveśopāyo@yamāṇavaḥ parikīrtitaḥ śrīmaheśvaranāthena yo hṛtsthena mamoditaḥ / śrībrahmayāmale coktaṃ śrīmān rāvo daśātmakaḥ sthūlaḥ sūkṣmaḥ paro hṛdyaḥ kaṇṭhyastālavya eva ca / sarvataśca vibhuryo@sau vibhutvapadadāyakaḥ jitarāvo mahāyogī saṃkrāmetparadehagaḥ / parāṃ ca vindati vyāptiṃ pratyahaṃ hyabhyaseta tam tāvadyāvadarāve sā rāvāllīyeta rāviṇī / atra bhāvanayā dehagatopāyaiḥ pare pathi

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v101] For one desiring distinction, bliss arises before touching fullness; even from that, lightning-strike-like, body-abandoned.

[tal-a05-v102] In the abode, for a moment, from immersion arises clear flooding, like water and dust, from practiced consciousness-body unity loss.

[tal-a05-v103] From own force entry and body looseness one obtains trembling; when dissolved, in certainty of body identity within enjoyment.

[tal-a05-v104] One sleeps before rooted in consciousness-self; then rooted in true state, consciousness as world-self.

[tal-a05-v105] Knowing, one reels; reeling is great pervasion, remembered; in self nonself conception, indeed true in nonself.

[tal-a05-v106] Self-conceit in body etc is bondage; liberation however is its dissolution; in beginning nonself selfhood, dissolved, obtained in own self.

[tal-a05-v107] In self nonself destruction great pervasion proceeds; bliss, arising, trembling, sleep, and reeling are fivefold.

[tal-a05-v108] Thus said teaching indeed in holy Malinivijayottara, in this shown bliss etc fivefold, when.

[tal-a05-v109] The yogi sometimes forcefully enters the lordship of each wheel, as the body, though pervaded by consciousness, is governed by the all-lord.

[tal-a05-v110] Just as the eye can know form, so entry into a wheel somewhere can make someone or something arise.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-vivikṣoḥ pūrṇatāsparśātprāgānandaḥ prajāyate / tato@pi vidyudāpātasadṛśe dehavarjite dhāmni kṣaṇaṃ samāveśādudbhavaḥ prasphuṭaṃ plutiḥ / jalapāṃsuvadabhyastasaṃviddehaikyahānitaḥ svabalākramaṇāddehaśaithilyāt kampamāpnuyāt / galite dehatādātmyaniścaye@ntarbhukhatvataḥ nidrāyate purā yāvanna rūḍhaḥ saṃvidātmani / tataḥ satyapade rūḍho viśvātmatvena saṃvidam saṃvidan ghūrṇate ghūrṇirmahāvyāptiryataḥ smṛtā / ātmanyanātmābhimatau satyāmeva hyanātmani ātmābhimāno dehādau bandho muktistu tallayaḥ / ādāvanātmanyātmatve līne labdhe nijātmani ātmanyanātmatānāśe mahāvyāptiḥ pravartate / ānanda udbhavaḥ kampo nindrā ghūrṇiśca pañcakam ityuktamata eva śrīmālinīvijayottare / pradarśite@sminnānandaprabhṛtau pañcake yadā yogī viśettadā tattaccakreśatvaṃ haṭhādvrajet / yathā sarveśinā bodhenākrāntāpi tanuḥ kvacit kiṃcitkartuṃ prabhavati cakṣuṣā rūpasaṃvidam / tathaiva cakre kutrāpi praveśātko@pi saṃbhavet

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v111] The bliss wheel, originating at the fire point and bulb, is called such; tremor, heart-palate, sleep, and whirling are signs, and an upward coil may arise.

[tal-a05-v112] This is clearly stated in the mantra-head doctrine; thus the supreme heart of utterance-rest is shown.

[tal-a05-v113] That unmanifest sign, with undivided human, Shiva, and power, is where this universe is known as dissolved within measure.

[tal-a05-v114] This is its mark: the clear immersion of full-power Bhairava awareness in the unfolding of the bodily path.

[tal-a05-v115] He, with the state of covered i-ness unfolding, has this manifest-unmanifest sign, the potency of mantra, ranging from supreme to inferior.

[tal-a05-v116] Human power unfolding is differentiated from Shiva form; that immersion subordinates Shiva i-ness with differentiation.

[tal-a05-v117] That manifest sign is a particular throb-form of consciousness; from the manifest arises accomplishment, from manifest-unmanifest duality liberation, and from the unmanifest the first power of the supreme, in this unsurpassed discussion.

[tal-a05-v118] The manifest human sign, called self, is where the universe is offered; from that dissolved, the unmanifest remains in it.

[tal-a05-v119] By that, this self sign rests in the supreme unmanifest, full of Shiva-power atom nature; this discussion is not about the unsurpassed abode.

[tal-a05-v120] This threefold distinction of one throb is established in this sign; one devoted to devotion-rest may always stand here.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-ānandacakraṃ vahnyaśri kanda udbhava ucyate / kampo hṛttālu nidrā ca ghūrṇiḥ syādūrdhvakuṇḍalī etacca sphuṭamevoktaṃ śrīmantraiśirase mate / evaṃ pradarśitoccāraviśrāntihṛdayaṃ param yattadavyaktaliṅgaṃ nṛśivaśaktyavibhāgavat / atra viśvamidaṃ līnamatrāntaḥsthaṃ ca gamyate idaṃ tallakṣaṇaṃ pūrṇaśaktibhairavasaṃvidaḥ / dehagādhvasamunmeṣe samāveśastu yaḥ sphuṭaḥ ahantācchāditonmeṣibhāvedaṃbhāvayuk sa ca / vyaktāvyaktamidaṃ liṅgaṃ mantravīryaṃ parāparam naraśaktisamunmeṣi śivarūpādvibheditam / yannyakkṛtaśivāhantāsamāveśaṃ vibhedavat viśeṣaspandarūpaṃ tad vyaktaṃ liṅgaṃ cidātmakam / vyaktātsiddhiprasavo vyaktāvyaktāddvayaṃ vimokṣaśca / avyaktādbalamādyaṃ parasya nānuttare tviyaṃ carcā ātmākhyaṃ yadvyaktaṃ naraliṅgaṃ tatra viśvamarpayataḥ / vyaktāvyaktaṃ tasmādgalite tasmiṃstadavyaktam tenātmaliṅgametat parame śivaśaktyaṇusvabhāvamaye / avyakte viśrāmyati nānuttaradhāmagā tviyaṃ carcā ekasya spandanasyaiṣā traidhaṃ bhedavyavasthitiḥ / atra liṅge sadā tiṣṭhet pūjāviśrāntitatparaḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v121] The beautiful lingam, heart of the yogini, gives birth to some consciousness through the union of seed and womb.

[tal-a05-v122] Here, without effort, all deities dwell in the bliss-filled abode, being of eternally arisen consciousness.

[tal-a05-v123] Here shines the difficult power of Bhairava, with contraction and expansion, and without contraction and expansion.

[tal-a05-v124] Sprinkled by the bliss stream of this lingam's union and emission, the very true universe always newly arises.

[tal-a05-v125] Here the supreme means is described by sameness alone; even when lamps blaze, why would the sun not shine?

[tal-a05-v126] In objects, in their enjoyment, and in pain or pleasure arising from them, even without entering them, minds absorbed know the inner joy of activity ceasing.

[tal-a05-v127] In the true self, in consciousness greatness, in mind, and in such service, the yogi stands clearly, and that reality full of rays is to be perceived.

[tal-a05-v128] Thus the recitation method is declared; the instrument is examined, and that was spoken by the supreme lord in the three-headed scripture.

[tal-a05-v129] By grasped, grasper, consciousness, pervasion, abandonment, impulsion, and placement, the instrument is called sevenfold practice preceded by awareness.

[tal-a05-v130] In impulsion preceded by its pervasion, the instrument's self-establishment is to be understood from the guru's mouth, although the instrument is clear.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-yoginīhṛdayaṃ liṅgamidamānandasundaram / bījayonisamāpattyā sūte kāmapi saṃvidam atra prayāsavirahātsarvo@sau devatāgaṇaḥ / ānandapūrṇe dhāmnyāste nityoditacidātmakaḥ atra bhairavanāthasya sasaṃkocavikāsikā / bhāsate durghaṭā śaktirasaṃkocavikāsinaḥ etalliṅgasamāpattivisargānandadhārayā / siktaṃ tadeva sadviśvaṃ śaśvannavanavāyate anuttare@bhyupāyo@tra tādrūpyādeva varṇitaḥ / jvaliteṣvapi dīpeṣu gharmāṃśuḥ kiṃ na bhāsate artheṣu tadbhogavidhau tadutthe duḥkhe sukhe vā galitābhiśaṅkam / anāviśanto@pi nimagnacittā jānanti vṛttikṣayasaukhyamantaḥ satyevātmani citsvabhāvamahasi svānte tathopaktiyāṃ tasmai kurvati tatpracāravivaśe satyakṣavarge@pi ca / satsvartheṣu sukhādiṣu sphuṭataraṃ yadbhedavandhyodayaṃ yogī tiṣṭhati pūrṇaraśmivibhavastattattvamācīyatām ityuccāravidhiḥ proktaḥ karaṇaṃ pravivicyate / taccetthaṃ triśiraḥśāstre parameśena bhāṣitam grāhyagrāhakacidvyāptityāgākṣepaniveśanaiḥ / karaṇaṃ saptadhā prāhurabhyāsaṃ bodhapūrvakam tadvyāptipūrvamākṣepe karaṇaṃ svapratiṣṭhatā / guruvaktrācca boddhavyaṃ karaṇaṃ yadyapi sphuṭam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v131] Yet for protection of scripture, it will be described before that: this recitation, which is shining and standing there.

[tal-a05-v132] The sound-letter, mostly an imitation of the unmanifest, is called the seed of creation and dissolution, and its principal form is known.

[tal-a05-v133] By the power of habit the yogi attains consciousness-nature; likewise in voids with or without seed, from beginning to end, again and again.

[tal-a05-v134] When remembered or uttered, that consciousness arises; external object-convention dependent sounds, such as pot and the like, also arise.

[tal-a05-v135] They too would create object-meditation in the self, like a mind-kingdom; thus the supreme lord said: Bhairava pervades all.

[tal-a05-v136] Thus, by continuous utterance of the Bhairava word, Shiva; it is also said in the Shri Trika, prior to mantra extraction.

[tal-a05-v137] Memory is recollection prior; in all beings, truly, it is mantra-nature, causing attainment of that meditated nature.

[tal-a05-v138] Memory produces own-nature; in all beings it colors, by many forms, situated everywhere.

[tal-a05-v139] Attainment of one's own nature is consciousness in ultimate truth; know then manifestation-abiding; that existence is called supreme.

[tal-a05-v140] What then? Without convention, those seed-points throb consciousness, yet they would not lead to consciousness-means.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tathāpyāgamarakṣārthaṃ tadagre varṇayiṣyate / ukto ya eṣa uccārastatra yo@sau sphuran sthitaḥ avyaktānukṛtiprāyo dhvanirvarṇaḥ sa kathyate / sṛṣṭisaṃhārabījaṃ ca tasya mukhyaṃ vapurviduḥ tadabhyāsavaśādyāti kramādyogī cidātmatām / tathā hyanacke sācke vā kādau sānte punaḥpunaḥ smṛte proccārite vāpi sā sā saṃvitprasūyāte / bāhyārthasamayāpekṣā ghaṭādyā dhvanayo@pi ye te@pyarthabhāvanāṃ kuryurmanorājyavadātmani / taduktaṃ parameśena bhairavo vyāpako@khile iti bhairavaśabdasya saṃtatoccāraṇācchivaḥ / śrīmattraiśirase@pyuktaṃ mantroddhārasya pūrvataḥ smṛtiśca smaraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvabhāveṣu vastutaḥ / mantrasvarūpaṃ tadbhāvyasvarūpāpattiyojakam smṛtiḥ svarūpajanikā sarvabhāveṣu rañjikā / anekākārarūpeṇa sarvatrāvasthitena tu svasvabhāvasya saṃprāptiḥ saṃvittiḥ paramārthataḥ / vyaktiniṣṭhā tato viddhi sattā sā kīrtitā parā kiṃ punaḥ samayāpekṣāṃ vinā ye bījapiṇḍakāḥ / saṃvidaṃ spandapantyete neyuḥ saṃvidupāyatām

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v141] Due to absence of the expressible, from the indifferent consciousness-throb of its own abode, by breath-exhilaration and restraint, there is fullness in seed-points.

[tal-a05-v142] First consciousness is of bliss-sigh and right equality; feeling indeed is first, the touch of supreme consciousness.

[tal-a05-v143] In the heart, throat, and lips, the three abodes, deeply expanding, the fourteenth entry is that which is unified with that self.

[tal-a05-v144] Then, in the visarga-utterance portion, the devoted chanter leads both paths to the twelve-end together with the heart.

[tal-a05-v145] From the end of the kunda process, within the central channel of bliss, vibration brings the seed.

[tal-a05-v146] The dissolution seed is space in the heart, expanded labial form at the head, fire triangle at palate and throat, and bindu situated at the upper place.

[tal-a05-v147] By this reasoning, the wise one devoted to letter recitation enters the supreme highest abode quickly.

[tal-a05-v148] By the word letter, blue and so on, or in the dikshottara, one remembers dissolution fire and wind together with Rudra bindu.

[tal-a05-v149] In the heart, the absorbed one sees the target after seven days, variegated like spark fire in blue, yellow, red, and other colors.

[tal-a05-v150] It blazes in the heart lotus, awakened by the seed lamp; the bindu shines like a lamp, like a dense sun.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-vācyābhāvādudāsīnasaṃvitspandātsvadhāmataḥ / prāṇollāsanirodhābhyāṃ bījapiṇḍeṣu pūrṇatā sukhasītkārasatsamyaksāmyaprathamasaṃvidaḥ / saṃvedanaṃ hi prathamaṃ sparśo@nuttarasaṃvidaḥ hṛtkaṇṭhyoṣṭhyatridhāmāntarnitarāṃ pravikāsini / caturdaśaḥ praveśo ya ekīkṛtatadātmakaḥ tato visargoccārāṃśe dvādaśāntapathāvubhau / hṛdayena sahaikadhyaṃ nayate japatatparaḥ kandahṛtkaṇṭhatālvagrakauṇḍilīprakriyāntataḥ / ānandamadhyanāḍyantaḥ spandanaṃ bījamāvahet saṃhārabījaṃ khaṃ hṛtsthamoṣṭhyaṃ phullaṃ svamūrdhani / tejastryaśraṃ tālukaṇṭhe bindurūrdhvapade sthitaḥ ityenayā budho yuktyā varṇajapyaparāyaṇaḥ / anuttaraṃ paraṃ dhāma praviśedacirāt sudhīḥ varṇaśabdena nīlādi yadvā dīkṣottare yathā / saṃhāranragnimaruto rudrabinduyutānsmaret hṛdaye tanmayo lakṣyaṃ paśyetsaptadinādatha / visphuliṅgāgnivannīlapītaraktādicitritam jājvalīti hṛdambhoje bījadīpaprabodhitam / dīpavajjvalito bindurbhāsate vighanārkavat

chunks.l2:
[tal-a05-v151] By this self-luminous self, the one-minded attains identity with Shiva, as copper becomes gold when pierced by mercury.

[tal-a05-v152] This is an indication; in all mantras one should mark whatever letter net born of resolve, for it is material.

[tal-a05-v153] That stands as if non-material through excess of consciousness; therefore, rooted in such a form, it grows in consciousness.

[tal-a05-v154] With uncovered form and no condition, the clear-minded sees the unbroken form of consciousness in blue, yellow, pleasure, and pain.

[tal-a05-v155] As the gurus have said, therefore variety among the means is shown through utterance, action, meditation, and letters.

[tal-a05-v156] The method for attaining the supreme word is thinking nothing, power, and meditation, and that again.

[tal-a05-v157] In meditation, utterance, and place-conception, he too should resort to sequence, treating that as external.

[tal-a05-v158] A supreme yogi who skips sequence without power is like a eunuch or dead body; external and internal conception remains only conceptual.

[tal-a05-v159] Thus the method of supreme nondual means is declared, by the clear path, as external.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-svayaṃbhāsātmanānena tādātmyaṃ yātyananyadhīḥ / śivena hematāṃ yadvattāmraṃ sūtena vedhitam upalakṣaṇametacca sarvamantreṣu lakṣayet / yadyatsaṃkalpasaṃbhūtaṃ varṇajālaṃ hi bhautikam tat saṃvidādhikyavaśādabhautikamiva sthitam / atastathāvidhe rūpe rūḍho rohati saṃvidi anācchāditarūpāyāmanupādhau prasannadhīḥ / nīle pīte sukhe duḥkhe saṃvidrūpamakhaṇḍitam gurubhirbhāṣitaṃ tasmādupāyeṣu vicitratā / uccārakaraṇadhyānavarṇairebhiḥ pradarśitaḥ anuttarapadaprāptāvabhyupāyavidhikramaḥ / akiṃciccintanaṃ vīryaṃ bhāvanāyāṃ ca sā punaḥ dhyāne tadapi coccāre karaṇe so@pi taddhvanau / sa sthānakalpane bāhyamiti kramamupāśrayet laṅghanena paro yogī mandabuddhiḥ krameṇa tu / vīryaṃ vinā yathā ṣaṇṭhastasyāpyastyatha vā balam / mṛtadeha iveyaṃ syādbāhyāntaḥparikalpanā ityāṇave@nuttaratābhyupāyaḥ prokto nayaḥ spaṣṭapathena bāhyaḥ
